snippet.title: DEADBOOT - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3819020/DEADBOOT/

DEADBOOT is a fast-paced retro roguelike FPS. Blast through randomized levels, scavenge weapons and upgrades along the way, and see how far you can make it in this neon death zone.

If you want to be part of bringing it to life, join the community discord here: https://discord.gg/bfvEAnPsB6

Music: VIP - Ruzer. Courtesy of Epidemic Sound
